ship.name: ISV Meridian Dawn
ship.description: A three-deck long-range survey cruiser of the Meridian Compact, carrying 140 crew and a thousand-part machine shop to the unmapped Perseus Reach.

factions.name: Meridian Compact
factions.description: The civilian-run federation that built and crews the Meridian Dawn.

factions.name: Free Settlements
factions.description: Independent colonies along the Reach, friendly to survey ships that bring medicine and mail.

factions.name: Vael Hegemony
factions.description: A militarised neighbour that closes borders to anything armed or unannounced.

factions.name: Unclaimed
factions.description: Systems nobody has claimed, mostly because nobody has come back from them.

systems.name: Sol
systems.summary: Origin of the expedition. Departure from Ceres Yard was 214 days ago.

systems.name: Tau Ceti
systems.summary: First fuel depot on the outbound leg. Quiet, orderly, boring - which is the point.

systems.name: Epsilon Eridani
systems.summary: Young orange star with a dust belt; the Free Settlements run a relay and a hospital ship here.

systems.name: Luyten's Rest
systems.summary: Red dwarf with a tidally locked garden world. The last place to mail a letter.

systems.name: Vael Prime
systems.summary: Hegemony fleet anchorage. Transit permitted along the marked lane only; stray and they will ask why.

systems.name: Kepler Gate
systems.summary: A K dwarf orbited by a ring of machined debris. The survey buoy that reported it went silent in 1.8 seconds.

systems.name: Helios Reach
systems.summary: A bright white star with a spectacular debris disc. Primary survey target of the mission.

systems.name: Aegis
systems.summary: Newest Free Settlement, still building its first orbital ring. Eager for engineers.

systems.name: Nox
systems.summary: A flare star with a shrouded companion. Long-range sensors disagree about how many bodies orbit it.

systems.name: Perseus End
systems.summary: The edge of every chart. The mission's final waypoint, if the ship and the crew hold together.

waypoints.objective: Map the debris disc and sample the Helios b aurora
Investigate the Gate Ring and recover the silent buoy
Deliver medical supplies and reactor spares
Reach the edge of the chart

current.status: docked at relay, outbound transit cleared

timeline.title: Compact founded
timeline.text: Six worlds pool their shipyards to survey the dark between the stars.

timeline.title: Warp lattice proven
timeline.text: The Odyssey drive sustains warp 6 for nine days without coil failure.

timeline.title: Keel laid
timeline.text: A thousand-part machine shop is installed in the hull of the Meridian Dawn so she can build her own spares.

timeline.title: Departure
timeline.text: Meridian Dawn leaves Ceres Yard bound for the Perseus Reach.

logs.title: Departure
logs.text: Ceres Yard fell astern at 0600. Crew morale is high and the coffee is, for now, real.

logs.title: Coil drift
logs.text: Warp coil 4 runs 3 K warm at cruise. Not dangerous, but I am watching it. Reactor bus B needs a rebalance.

logs.title: Hydroponics fever
logs.text: Nine cases of mild spore allergy from the new fern cultivars. Moved the ferns to bay 3.

logs.title: Kepler Gate
logs.text: The buoy telemetry is wrong in a way that is too regular to be noise. I would very much like to look at it.

logs.title: Brig inventory
logs.text: Brig is empty. The armory is not. I intend to keep it that way.

logs.title: Galley supplies
logs.text: Replicator stock at 61 percent. The fruit bowls are the most popular item aboard and nobody will admit why.

logs.title: Luyten approach
logs.text: Docked at the Luyten relay. Mail sent, mail received. Vael patrol asked for our route; filed the northern lane.

logs.title: Unknown carrier
logs.text: A repeating carrier on 14.2 GHz from the direction of Kepler Gate. No modulation I recognise.

datapads.title: Welcome aboard
datapads.text: You are on the Meridian Dawn. Decks 1-3 are connected by two stair towers at mid-ship. Every console in the ship is networked: stand close, look at a screen and press E.

datapads.title: How the warp drive works (briefly)
datapads.text: A ring of eight lattice coils bends local space ahead of the hull. The reactor feeds the coils through three buses. Push the warp factor too high and the coils run hot; keep the temperature under 4800 K and the lattice sings, above it, it screams.

datapads.title: Crew code
datapads.text: 1. Nobody is alone on the ship. 2. The ship is everybody's. 3. If it is on fire, tell someone, then put it out. 4. Mail is sacred.

datapads.title: Kepler Gate dossier
datapads.text: A ring of manufactured debris 40 km across circles Kepler X. Surveyed once, from 6 light-minutes, by an automated buoy that stopped reporting 1.8 seconds after it resolved the ring. Approach with shields up.

glossary.text: Dimensionless drive setting. Warp 6 is the Meridian Dawn's cruise: about 3.2 light-years per day.
One of eight toroidal coils that shape the warp field.
Informal name for the unmapped region beyond Luyten's Rest.
The Meridian Compact, a federation of six worlds.
A shared electrical distribution line. The Meridian Dawn has three: A (command), B (engineering) and C (habitat).
Ship-day counter; one unit is about 8.8 hours.
